breaking_news.headline: The price of diesel hits a record high
breaking_news.summary: The price of diesel has reached an all-time high, a result of the war in Iran and Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries. That will matter across the supply chain.

breaking_news.headline: 'How do you know if it's real?' Luxury reseller faces Chanel lawsuit
breaking_news.summary: How do you know if a secondhand luxury good bought online is real? That's at the heart of a lawsuit filed by Chanel against the luxury reseller, The RealReal.

breaking_news.headline: Pulling the SNAP lever + Why Gen Zers bet (invest?) differently
breaking_news.summary: Changing SNAP eligibility actually can change consumption habits.

breaking_news.headline: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
breaking_news.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

breaking_news.headline: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

breaking_news.headline: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

breaking_news.headline: Union electricians welcome data center boom
breaking_news.summary: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

breaking_news.headline: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine's chief prosecutor resigns over call centre corruption scandal
breaking_news.summary: In his resignation letter, Ruslan Kravchenko denied the allegations against him, saying he did not want his office "to be used as a tool in political confrontation".

breaking_news.headline: North Korea and Russia open first road bridge linking both countries
breaking_news.summary: Relations between the neighbours have strengthened since the start of the Ukraine war.

breaking_news.headline: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
breaking_news.summary: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport.

breaking_news.headline: Nepal cracks down on online abuse of flood survivors
breaking_news.summary: Authorities will "show no leniency" to people who "belittle" those who are suffering, the prime minister says.

breaking_news.headline: Highest paid world leader to get salary increase of $1 million
breaking_news.summary: Singapore's prime minister Lawrence Wong will see his pay rise to 3.6 million Singapore dollars ($2.8m; £2.1m).

breaking_news.headline: Trial over alleged murders of Australian surfer brothers starts in Mexico
breaking_news.summary: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their US friend were found with gunshot wounds to their heads.

breaking_news.headline: Eiffel Tower shut by staff protest after female workers moved for religious visit
breaking_news.summary: An investigation will be launched into the incident, which left female employees "humiliated", a union representative says.

breaking_news.headline: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
breaking_news.summary: The threat against one of Canada's largest companies comes amid an escalating trade war between the two neighbours.

breaking_news.headline: 'JLR job cuts a cause for uncertainty and worry'
breaking_news.summary: Experts say they worry it could limit the company's ability to innovate in the future.

breaking_news.headline: 'Tirana teeth': Albania hopes to be the new Turkey for dental work
breaking_news.summary: The Balkan nation is aiming to become a new centre for medical tourism.

breaking_news.headline: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
breaking_news.summary: Users say they are losing money or risk having their accounts suspended because Meta struggles to identify scammers.

breaking_news.headline: Canada braces for prolonged trade war as counter-tariffs on US take effect
breaking_news.summary: The tariffs will apply to $20bn worth of American products, jeopardising the stability of the world's largest bilateral trading relationship.
